RootCanvas.ReturnUnavailable.zh: 当前操作结束后可返回主画布；共享内容编辑须先完成或取消。
RootCanvas.ReturnUnavailable.en: Return to Main after the current operation finishes. Complete or cancel shared content editing first.

RootCanvas.PrefabSingleRootUnsupported.zh: 此工程包含多个根画布。请先在源工程中将需要的内容导出为预制体，再置入或链接。
RootCanvas.PrefabSingleRootUnsupported.en: This project contains multiple root canvases. Export the desired content as a prefab from the source project before placing or linking it.

RootCanvas.MainHint.zh: 在主画布中创作；跟随主画布的透视与网格设置
RootCanvas.MainHint.en: Draw on the main canvas with its perspective and grid

RootCanvas.ForegroundHint.zh: 在屏幕平面创作，始终显示在主画布上方
RootCanvas.ForegroundHint.en: Draw in screen space, above the main canvas

RootCanvas.BackgroundHint.zh: 在屏幕平面创作，始终显示在主画布下方
RootCanvas.BackgroundHint.en: Draw in screen space, below the main canvas

RootCanvas.ScreenPlane.zh: 前景和背景画布固定在屏幕平面；透视和网格设置用于主画布。
RootCanvas.ScreenPlane.en: Foreground and background stay in screen space. Perspective and grid settings belong to the main canvas.
